scope: Novelty relative to inspected repository corpus; not worldwide novelty or proof correctness.

decisions.proposal: Prove the actual Gamma coefficient is a unit using a single polynomial residue for each prime, or factor-wise nonvanishing via multiplicative order.
nearest_prior: E068 product-unit decomposition for integer Pell/norm factors
decisions.delta: The new obligation is nonvanishing of the actual current-controller coefficient in each residue field, including q^2-1 and independent exponents; no earlier manuscript proposes its order-based factor test or one whole-polynomial residue certificate.
decisions.limits: Do not claim generic product units, modular congruence composition, or factoring coprimality is new. Preserve Nat subtraction lower bounds and zero-exponent endpoints.

decisions.proposal: Use exponent-map fixed points to prove x^(p^n)=x from x^p=x, then evaluate controller polynomials through a finite residue action.
decisions.delta: The invariant is the iterated exponent map, not a scanner or geometric period; it removes distinct repeated induction/Frobenius residue reasoning for the new controller constants.
decisions.limits: Existing finite residue calculations are assumptions/baseline, not new certificates to re-credit. A small helper must justify its aggregate code cost.

decisions.proposal: Replace the prime-power order proof split by the complete divisibility spectrum p^(k+1) | g^m-1 iff p^k | m.
nearest_prior: E099/E108 Pell power approximation budgets (different subject)
decisions.delta: No LTE, p-adic valuation spectrum, exact prime-power order or arbitrary-exponent spectrum proposal was found in the 28 packet manuscripts and targeted supporting-code searches.
decisions.limits: Preserve m=0,k=0 and exact first-lift hypotheses; give the full mathematical proof and avoid circular dependence on the order theorem being shortened.

decisions.proposal: Remove sixteen_pow_bound induction by setting t=4^r, rewriting 16^r=t^2, and proving 4t+2<=t^2 for t>=16.
decisions.delta: This is a concrete exponential-to-polynomial reduction at NativePellPower.sixteen_pow_bound, absent from the prior claims; it does not re-propose Pell approximation or geometric-sum libraries.
decisions.limits: Count the normal-form identities and proof of t>=16; do not infer compiler speed from source length.

decisions.proposal: Strengthen normalized_low_digit to every low field including e=0 and arbitrary bounded marker maps by using the previous cell top reset.
decisions.delta: The new information is the cyclic e=0 incoming-carry boundary and marker independence, derived from actual top_carry_digits. Generic local zero-carry cancellation is already assumed available.
decisions.limits: A proposal only to rewrite carry equations or package projection facts would duplicate the corpus. Demonstrate eliminated marker-specific assumptions and unify real clients.

decisions.proposal: Use the actual periodic top-field reset to normalize each cell by an acyclic finite fold from zero and prove locality under edits.
nearest_prior: E066 explicit least/greatest full-cycle carry formulas
E073 carry uniqueness with fixed raw and digits
decisions.delta: A proved synchronization/reset boundary splits the cyclic normalizer into independent cells. This gives a constructive per-cell evaluation and edit-locality theorem, beyond closed formulas or uniqueness of a full cycle.
decisions.limits: Do not replace the general arbitrary-predecessor fixedpoint theorem. Derive every cell reset from the actual raw budget and cover N=1/wraparound; raw convolution changes can affect neighboring cells, so locality must name the raw cells that stay equal.

decisions.proposal: Use translation of an arbitrary size-a seed subset in ZMod T to realize any sum when gcd(a,T)=1.
decisions.delta: No exact translated fixed-cardinality subset-sum interface found. It removes the interval shape from the existence mechanism.
decisions.limits: Current ControllerIntervalSums already has a short interval-sum formula and explicit startFor. No immediate net shortening is established if interval APIs and exact witnesses are retained.

decisions.proposal: Shorten origin_reflected_zero by a direct modulo2011 support contradiction instead of reconstructing the previous cell.
nearest_prior: E033 shared ambient field residues and support-zero helper
E102 support separation through quotient homomorphism
decisions.delta: The exact target is newly added, but the advertised residue/support-zero mechanism already covers this form of elimination.
decisions.limits: Could be a small application of the assumed baseline API; do not advertise it as a separate new research idea under the user non-repetition constraint.

decisions.proposal: Replace finite radix prefix bounds by generic digit-length/range/library geometry.
decisions.delta: Generic word-bound reuse is already proposed. A new exact cell-reset theorem would need to carry the novelty instead.
